name: pixelcut-video-editor
description: PixelCut — free public-beta video editor for Windows (Electron + FFmpeg) and Android (Capacitor + Media3)
author: Kaell Soares Calacina

scripts.test:export: node scripts/test-editor.cjs && node scripts/test-projects.cjs && node scripts/test-project-path.cjs && node scripts/test-android-persist.cjs && node scripts/test-stability.cjs && node scripts/test-transitions.cjs && node scripts/test-ffprobe.cjs && node scripts/test-export.cjs && node scripts/test-export-duration.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npx --yes electron-builder@26.18.0 --win nsis
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
